title: Autonomous Long-Running Coordinator Build Plan
objective: Build, integrate, and prove an executable coordinator that can continue software development autonomously until the approved build queue and all required testing are complete, while routing around slice-local blockers and stopping only when no safe independent work remains and user input is the sole resolution.

architecture_boundary.agentic_wiki: Provider-neutral deterministic coordinator engine, journal, projection, scheduler, leases, recovery, evidence, and public API/CLI.
architecture_boundary.plugin: Workflow policy, project adapter selection, host-specific worker and capability adapters, preflight, status presentation, and immutable reusable contracts.
architecture_boundary.project_memory: Project-specific intent, queue, authority, overlays, reports, incidents, design evidence, supervision requests, external connections, and completion evidence.
architecture_boundary.workers: Slice-owned code, tests, fixtures, and reports only; never shared control state or canonical memory.
architecture_boundary.coordinator: Sole writer for shared control projections and canonical memory; serial integrator of validated worker output.

continuous_loop: Acquire or renew the fenced coordinator lease.
Verify the event journal and rebuild or validate the current projection.
Reconcile active workers, command receipts, Git worktrees, resource state, supervision decisions, budgets, and stop requests.
Expire stale leases and preserve late or abandoned worker evidence.
Derive ready, waiting, blocked, terminal, and unreachable work from the dependency graph.
Admit safe deduplicated work proposals and split blocked work when an independent enabling slice exists.
Compile bounded memory and design context for each ready assignment.
Dispatch nonconflicting work up to configured capacity, normally six workers.
Collect reports and capability results, validate ownership and evidence, and run required review.
Integrate accepted work serially, rerun configured validation, and record command receipts and Git proof.
Record blockers and supervision requests without stopping independent work.
Update projections, semantic HTML views, dashboard snapshots, checkpoints, and completion evidence.
Replenish the queue from accepted discoveries, validation failures, unresolved requirements, and remaining definition-of-done conditions.
Repeat immediately until the completion predicate passes or the only remaining work is blocked exclusively on user input.
global_invariants: Exactly one fenced coordinator may mutate shared control state.
At most six active workers unless project authority configures a lower limit.
No two active writing assignments may own overlapping paths.
Every state transition is journaled, attributable, replayable, and idempotent.
Every accepted result is bound to a lease token, assignment, report, changed-file digest, validation evidence, and integration receipt.
A blocked slice never prevents an independent ready slice from running.
Two failed bounded repair attempts stop only the affected slice unless a safety boundary applies globally.
Credentials and PHI values never enter artifacts, logs, Git, prompts, screenshots, reports, or exceptions.
Queue drain cannot be declared while ready, active, stale, undisposed, or required dependent work remains.
Completion is reconstructed from journal, projection, Git, validation, and evidence rather than inferred from worker exit status or chat.

continue_when: any ready implementation, test, documentation, repair, migration, review, recovery, integration, or evidence item exists
an enabling slice can reduce or isolate a blocker
an independent slice does not depend on the blocked decision
a transient resource outage can be retried within policy
a future-resource note can be recorded while current implementation continues
whole_run_stop_allowed_when: the user explicitly stops the run
a safety, privacy, permission, or supervision boundary applies to every remaining item
a configured hard time or usage boundary is reached
all required work and testing pass the completion predicate
stop_rule.user_input_block_condition: User input is a valid blocking condition only after the escalation ladder is exhausted, the affected decision cannot be made reversibly inside authority, and no independent or enabling work remains.
stop_rule.on_user_return: Do not cancel safe active work. At the next reasonable boundary, reconcile results and present the chronological supervision queue before dispatching lower-priority optional work.

work_items.title: Versioned runtime domain model
deliverables: typed run, slice, dependency, attempt, lease, blocker, stop request, budget, command receipt, capability invocation, supervision request, and completion models
strict schemas and legal transition table
acceptance: duplicate IDs, dangling dependencies, self-dependencies, cycles, invalid timestamps, unknown statuses, and illegal transitions are rejected
all models round-trip to stable JSON

work_items.title: Coordinator event envelope and hash chain
deliverables: monotonic sequence, run ID, event ID, idempotency key, causation and correlation IDs, actor, prior hash, payload hash, schema version, projection revision
acceptance: reordering, duplication, deletion, mutation, and forged hashes are detected
tests: property tests over generated event streams

work_items.title: Durable append-only coordinator journal
deliverables: atomic framed append with flush, fsync, and directory sync
acceptance: concurrent appenders lose no events
a torn final record does not invalidate complete prior records

work_items.title: Pure state reducer and projection cache
deliverables: atomic disposable projection snapshots with journal offset and hash
acceptance: replay twice yields byte-equivalent state
cache deletion or corruption is repaired by replay

work_items.title: Transactional command receipts and idempotency
deliverables: planned, started, succeeded, failed, cancelled, and outcome-unknown receipts
acceptance: restart cannot duplicate an accepted external effect
uncertain outcomes remain explicit and reviewable
tests: crash before and after each receipt transition

work_items.title: Coordinator ownership lease with fencing
deliverables: host/process identity, epoch, expiry, fencing token
acceptance: only the newest live epoch may write
expired coordinators are rejected after takeover

work_items.title: Dependency graph evaluator
deliverables: derived ready, waiting, blocked, terminal, and unreachable sets
acceptance: diamond and fan-out graphs schedule deterministically
independent nodes remain ready when another branch blocks

work_items.title: Storage adapter protocol
deliverables: atomic JSON source and generated HTML view contract
acceptance: adapter behavior is identical independent of artifact root

work_items.title: BMAD storage adapter
acceptance: existing user BMAD artifacts are preserved
all coordinator artifacts resolve through the logical API

work_items.title: Lightweight storage adapter
acceptance: no BMAD dependency or project-local skill copies are introduced

work_items.title: Worker assignment and acknowledgement protocol
deliverables: immutable assignment packet with context hash, base commit, owned and forbidden paths, tests, permissions, lease policy, report destination
acceptance: unbounded assignments, stale bases, missing context, and malformed acknowledgements are rejected

work_items.title: Slice lease manager with path fencing
deliverables: acquire, acknowledge, heartbeat, release, stale, reassign, supersede
ancestor and descendant path conflict detection
acceptance: only one live lease owns a slice and path set

work_items.title: Provider-neutral worker executor
deliverables: dispatch, poll, heartbeat, collect, cancel interface
typed outcomes for success, retryable, blocked, supervision, unavailable, and malformed

work_items.title: Git repository and dirty-tree classifier
deliverables: branch, HEAD, remotes, worktrees, staged, unstaged, untracked, ignored, ahead/behind snapshot
acceptance: user/unowned dirt is preserved and overlapping slices are held while independent paths remain runnable

work_items.title: Git worktree isolation adapter
acceptance: writing workers cannot collide or escape owned paths
tests: branch collision, stale worktree, forbidden edit, and cleanup tests

work_items.title: Worker report admission and integrity
deliverables: JSON report source and semantic HTML view
changed-file hashes, tests, blockers, memory delta, capability evidence, lease token

work_items.title: Validation command runner
deliverables: bounded subprocess runner with timeout, cancellation, output hashing, redaction, command receipts, and deterministic environment
acceptance: exit status alone never marks a slice complete

work_items.title: Serial integration controller
deliverables: ancestry, ownership, review, validation, and report verification
acceptance: workers never merge shared state

work_items.title: Retry, repair, and backoff ledger
deliverables: classification for infrastructure retry, validation repair, blocker, cancellation, terminal failure

work_items.title: Typed blocker lifecycle

work_items.title: Dynamic slice discovery and queue replenishment

work_items.title: Deterministic reconciliation tick
deliverables: single pure decision pass that processes results, expiry, dependencies, proposals, capacity, conflicts, stops, and dispatch intents

work_items.title: Continuous coordinator runner

work_items.title: Stop, time, usage, and budget semantics

work_items.title: Startup recovery and in-flight reconciliation

work_items.title: Deterministic orchestration test harness

parallel_execution_rules: The coordinator continuously computes the ready set from dependencies; workstream labels do not create stop boundaries.
After AC-008, BMAD and lightweight adapters may proceed concurrently.
After AC-011, worker protocol, Git classification, validation runner, and capability discovery may proceed concurrently where paths do not overlap.
After AC-022, runner, supervision, observability, design evidence, and recovery work may advance concurrently according to dependencies.
Verification items begin as soon as their dependencies exist; testing is not deferred to the end.
A worker completion may create repair or discovery items, which enter the same queue and must be drained before completion.
completion_predicate: All AC work items and all accepted discovered items have validated terminal dispositions.
No ready, active, stale, waiting-on-resolvable-dependency, undisposed report, uncertain command, or required supervision item remains.
Full unit, property, concurrency, fault-injection, BMAD E2E, lightweight E2E, PHI, Git, plugin, documentation, security, and soak gates pass.
The event journal verifies and independently rebuilds the final projection.
Local and configured remote Git evidence match the accepted integrated state.
The immutable completion manifest reports every condition individually and passes reconstruction.
No credential, PHI canary, worker process, lease, lock, temporary worktree, or unbounded artifact remains.
Plugin source/cache parity and fresh-context adapter smoke tests pass.
Run-state, handoff, branch ledger, incident summary, dashboard snapshot, and control index point to the final evidence.
